evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep said: 'This would take within the next five to ten minutes of your time would that be okay?' — framed time-box and wait for yes, but did not explicitly promise 'a quote you can depend on' or fully match the recognizable version.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep asked: 'Do you have any concerns or any important things that you wanted to answer during this call today?' — asked before probing logistics.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer said 'I don't think so' to concerns. No concerns raised, so N/A applies.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No concerns were raised by customer, so no reflection opportunity existed — N/A applies.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Rep gathered: property type (two-story house, one-bedroom apartment), floor info, rooms (3 bedrooms), walking distance (<10 ft / ~30 ft), additional spaces (garage), special considerations (partial move, heavy items self-moved, temporary 3-month stay), parking access (driveway, street), and access concerns (none). Nearly all seven items covered.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Rep never asked 'Would you like us to pack your items into boxes for you?' — packing was only mentioned in context of customer self-packing small items to save time.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Rep asked: 'How many boxes are removing?' and then provided anchor: 'Because normally based on your home size, it would take with between fifty to sixty boxes. Do you feel that you fall within that range?' — box count was asked and anchored.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep gave typical range: '1600 square foot home would normally take two movers that is between six to eight hours' and personalized: 'So, in your case, we're coming from a two story house on going to the new location which is a one bedroom appointment... estimated time is between six to seven hours, estimated cost would be $1,540' — both present.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep disclosed: 'we charge an already rate of 110 dollars per hour per mover' and 'everything is already included on the early weight' (gas, truck, taxes, insurance, tools, etc.). Also framed: 'minimum of two and a half hours once you go over that it will always be prorated into fifteen minute increments' — fee transparency and 2.5-hour minimum / 15-minute increments both present.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Rep never asked 'Does that feel fair?' or equivalent. No pause check for customer acceptance of the estimate.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Rep said: 'we have on time guarantee we value your time. So, if you cannot make it to the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill' — discount terms and immediate applicability stated in recognizable form.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Rep said: 'we have no worry damage coverage included. On the already way that you're paying us we will provide up to $2,000 per move. That is to repair replace and reimburse for your items' and later 'there's no hidden fees of any type' — covers $2,000, no deductible/fine-print framing present, and built into rate (not add-on). Full delivery.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Rep asked 'truly believe during the best mover in town would you like our help with your remove' — this is the explicit ask, not a closing loop confirmation of the Two Promises. No reflection back like 'Does that put those to rest?' was asked.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep asked: 'Do you still have any other questions before I let you go?' — this is an empty throwaway question, not the genuine 'What's still concerning you about this move?' version.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Rep never asked 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' or similar catch-all.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep asked: 'would you like our help with your remove' — plainly stated, no softening or built-in out offered.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Rep said: 'If something comes up and things changes on your end. Then you can always reschedule or cancel with a quick call, no fees for that.' — rate lock / no-deposit framing was mentioned ('there's no deposit required, no res securing your spot').
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Rep confirmed: move date (Friday 16th October, 8:30–9:00 AM). Rep mentioned confirmation email would cover 'pricing, how it works' and 'address, phone number' but did not explicitly confirm phone number, addresses, arrival window range, crew size (stated earlier as 2 movers but not re-confirmed), or crew notes about customer concerns on this call. Partial confirmation.

top_strength: Rep gathered comprehensive logistics details across both locations (property types, floors, room counts, walking distances, access concerns, parking, and special move circumstances) and delivered both Two Promises fully and clearly before the ask.
coaching_note: Rep skipped the critical 'Does that feel fair?' pause after the estimate, omitted the packing-services offer, and closed with a throwaway 'any questions' rather than a genuine final-concerns check—three high-value items in the script that drive confidence and catch unstated objections.
